covers.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: WeChat mini-program chemistry topic cover, landscape 1280x900
Primary request: Create an original, text-free cover illustration for the junior-high chemistry topic "Introduction to Chemistry and Laboratory Safety".

Subject: two middle-school students wearing splash goggles and lab coats observe a safe color-change demonstration while a teacher supervises from beside them; hands remain away from chemicals.
Style/medium: polished semi-realistic editorial educational illustration, tactile glass and metal, accurate plausible apparatus, not a stock photo.
Composition/framing: wide 1280x900 landscape, strong central workbench, full objects visible with generous edge padding, layered depth, no split layout, no empty card frame.
Lighting/mood: clear daylight, curious, calm, responsible.
Color palette: balanced white, teal, sunflower yellow, coral red and charcoal accents; avoid a one-hue blue palette.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark; no open flame, no unsafe handling, no tasting or smelling, no improvised apparatus; no distorted hands or glassware; do not depict a home experiment.

manualReview.notes: Safety goggles, teacher supervision and stable school-laboratory apparatus are visible; no readable text or unsafe action.
